summary: SRD phase (Provider Account Mgmt + Secret Store + Environment Selection) fully verified. Ran full backend suite serially (115 passed, incl. 8 new provider_accounts tests) and end-to-end frontend tests on Providers + Payments screens against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Tenant selector dropdown lists many stale TEST_/Isolated tenants from previous test iterations — consider auto-cleanup of TEST_ prefixed tenants at teardown; not a bug but noise for manual QA.
SANDBOX badge in the header is a hardcoded pill — it does not reflect the environment of a specific payment; per SRD phase, it is informational only, which is fine.
The Providers page 'CREDENTIALS: set' label is good; consider also showing partial credentials_ref (masked prefix) as tooltip for operator debugging (nice-to-have).
seed_data_creation: One sandbox payment created via UI in acme tenant (reference UITEST-<ts>, $12.34, succeeded). Backend pytest created transient TEST_-prefixed tenants (visible in topbar).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend must be run with -n0 (webhook xdist race). Public URL from frontend/.env is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://pay-gateway-core.preview.emergentagent.com. Login and switch tenant to Acme Commerce via data-testid=tenant-selector -> tenant-option-acme. Verified: secret store returns only credentials_ref starting 'sec_' (raw never leaked); per-(tenant,provider,env) uniqueness with proper 400s; mock live rejected with 'environment' message; PATCH enable/disable + PUT rotate keeps same ref; DELETE removes account and secret; payment env selection sandbox=OK, live=400, missing=defaults to sandbox; frontend has provider-environment-select (mock exposes only sandbox option), no dynamic credential inputs for mock (no required_credentials), provider-toggle-<id> flips Disable<->Enable and updates card, provider-credentials-status-<id> shows CREDENTIALS: set, payment-environment-select present in New Payment dialog and sandbox payment creation succeeds and shows in table.
